scripts.infra:up: npm run infra:build && docker compose -f ../docker-compose.test.yml up -d
scripts.triggerAllTests-login: npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e --browser chrome --env tags="@login"
scripts.triggerAllTests-statistics: npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e --browser chrome --env tags="@statistics"
scripts.triggerAllTests-bussiness: npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e --browser chrome --env tags="@bussinessFeatures"
scripts.triggerAllTests-normal: npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e --browser chrome --env tags="not @login and not @statistics and not @bussinessFeatures"
scripts.triggerAllTests: npm run triggerAllTests-login && npm run triggerAllTests-statistics && npm run triggerAllTests-normal && npm run triggerAllTests-bussiness
scripts.test:e2e: npm run infra:up && npm run infra:wait && npm run triggerAllTests; npm run report:merge && npm run report:generate; npm run infra:down
